quotes.verbatim_quote: Anytime one of the voices moves a distance of a 3rd, you can fill in that interval with a melodic passing tone. This works well for individual melodies, counterpoint (2 voices), 3-part and 4-part chords.
quotes.why_load_bearing: Core rule — single generative principle across solo, counterpoint, and voicings.
